parameters.query: SELECT policy_code, category, canonical_question, answer_text, conditions, effective_from, effective_to, version, source_title, source_section, owner, approved, sensitivity, synthetic FROM hr.policy_item WHERE approved = true AND effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY policy_code ASC;

SELECT id, snapshot_version, content_hash, policy_count, token_estimate, is_active, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(snapshot_version) FROM hr.policy_snapshot), 0)::int AS max_version FROM hr.policy_snapshot WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1;

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF $1::boolean THEN
    -- Invalidate current active snapshot
    UPDATE hr.policy_snapshot
    SET is_active = false, invalidated_at = now()
    WHERE is_active = true;

    -- Insert new active snapshot version
    INSERT INTO hr.policy_snapshot (
      snapshot_version, content, content_hash, policy_count,
      token_estimate, source_versions, valid_from, is_active
    ) VALUES (
      $2::int,
      $3::text,
      $4::text,
      $5::int,
      $6::int,
      $7::jsonb,
      now(),
      true
    );
  END IF;
END $$;

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM hr.policy_snapshot WHERE is_active = true) AS active_snapshot_count,
  (SELECT snapshot_version FROM hr.policy_snapshot WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1) AS active_version,
  (SELECT content_hash FROM hr.policy_snapshot WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1) AS active_content_hash,
  (SELECT policy_count FROM hr.policy_snapshot WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1) AS active_policy_count,
  (SELECT token_estimate FROM hr.policy_snapshot WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1) AS active_token_estimate,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM hr.policy_snapshot) AS total_historical_snapshots;
